description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'RegisterRequest' that models user registration data with fields for name, email, password, and role, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: A Java class representing user registration data, used for transferring user information within the application.

methods.description: Returns the name of the user.

methods.description: Returns the email address of the user.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password of the user.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the user.
